lina_cs: Heads up — ArborLane usage fell ~62% WoW after their procurement lead changed. New IT stakeholder Christina is asking for a procurement RFP and mentioned evaluating SentinelAI.
omar_ae: ack. Do we have a timeline from procurement? any POC running now?
lina_cs: They start a 2-week POC next Tuesday per Christina. Procurement asked for cost/latency comparatives. :worried:
kevin_data: quick numbers from the dashboard — pulling now
kevin_data: ```
Account: arborlane
Last 7d reqs: 1,420
Prev 7d reqs: 3,750
Seat activity: 28 active -> 9 active
Avg latency (prod endpoint): 210ms -> 195ms
Token spend delta: -58% WoW
``` 
kevin_data: also seeing a spike in failed webhook acknowledgements around 03/06, possible integration flakiness
analytics-bot: ALERT: usage_drop_detected metric triggered for account arborlane (severity: medium). Link: https://app.redwood.com/dash/account/arborlane
omar_ae: thanks Kev. Lina — can you share the stakeholder mapping and the procurement ask? I'll prep a one-pager for the RFP comparison.
lina_cs: procurement asked: pricing, SLA, onboarding timeline, security/compliance (SOC2 req). Christina also wants a short demo of our private deployment options.
jemi_revops: playbook: 1) immediate check-in with Christina + AE (this week) 2) quick health remediation plan (30d) 3) formal RFP packet + side-by-side cost calc by Friday 4) offer canary Dedicated slot for POC if needed
lucy_success: I can own the remediation plan and the 30-day enablement checklist. Will run a quick audit of onboarding docs and enablement playbooks.
omar_ae: i'll draft RFP one-pager and competitive delta vs SentinelAI. Lina — can you intro Christina to me and cc lucy_success + jemi_revops?
lina_cs: on it, drafting intro now. @omar_ae @lucy_success @jemi_revops — propose 30-min sync tomorrow 10am PT? If that works i'll include Christina.
omar_ae: works for me. :thumbsup:
lucy_success: works
jemi_revops: can do
lina_cs: intro sent. Christina replied "10am PT works, procurement wants the packet by Friday" — copying her in the thread. We'll bring cost/latency, deployment options, and a clear onboarding timeline.
omar_ae: action items:
- omar_ae: RFP one-pager + competitive bullets (owner)
- kevin_data: verify webhook failures and share short root-cause (owner)
- lucy_success: remediation checklist + enablement timeline
- jemi_revops: pricing delta + Dedicated POC offer
- lina_cs: intro & schedule invite
lina_cs: noted. I'll also surface any open support tickets and recent session logs in the invite.
kevin_data: I'll have the webhook analysis and a suggested mitigation before the sync.
analytics-bot: NOTE: scheduled report for arborlane sent to #customer-success tomorrow 08:00 UTC
lina_cs: thanks team. Goal here: avoid churn, get procurement comfortable with timelines and a low-friction POC. I'll post meeting notes after today's sync. :pray:
